errors.text_span: The chart contains eight slices, representing English, Spanish, Russian, German, French, Chinese, and a combined “Other” category further specified as Catalan, Portuguese (Brazil), and Thai.
errors.evidence: The pie chart shows 8 slices total only if counting the three sublabels inside the Other wedge as separate subcategories; visually the chart has 8 labeled segments including Other, but the text lists 7 top-level categories and treats Other as a combined category with internal labels. More importantly, the figure presents 8 named slices around the pie: English, Spanish, Russian, German, French, Chinese, Thai, Portuguese (Brazil), Catalan, and Other is not a separate slice in addition to those sublabels. The description’s count/structure is misleading.
The description does not mention that there are no legend elements shown; the prompt asked to mention whether the chart includes a legend.
